cohort.split: development pilot, not official blind test

limits: Source image and mask assets remain private; no new data, fitted checkpoint or source workspace history is distributed.
Emission, mask geometry and diagnostic-control agreement are not accuracy or recall.
9mm controls were training cases; their results are not independent performance evidence.
Three related slides share a frame and study; observations are not an isolated causal caliber effect.
Pooled, metadata-conditioned and specialist fits were not trained or compared.
Ground-truth coverage for the four regions plus directed arrow is not established.
